title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You! — Episode5 For the Best Show

meta.Event Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Line: Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Our equipment may not make it in time...?
Could you elaborate?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: So, the truck carrying it is currently stuck on one of the mountain roads...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stuck...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, because of yesterday's heavy snow...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, that seems to be the case.
It's apparently going to be quite some time before it gets here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just to confirm, it's carrying the lanterns and launching devices we were planning on using for the climax, yes?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes, those were all that was left...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood.
Would you mind giving us a minute to think about how we should proceed?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Of course...!
I'm incredibly sorry, but thank you for being so understanding.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Things have been a bit hectic since we received news of it getting stuck, so if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. We'll try to come up with a plan as quickly as we can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No lanterns, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do we do, Rui?
You were really set on using those lanterns during the climax, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I was...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Did they just say something about the climax...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Strictly speaking, they aren't an integral part of the story...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As long as our Santa Clauses overcome all the trials and deliver their presents to the children, we'll be able to call it a happy ending.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, that is the bare minimum which we need to present. Even if we don't have those lanterns, all I'll need to do is make a couple of changes to the script...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need to make some other adjustments as well, of course.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're correct in terms of us still being able to go forward with this show given that you make some changes. But those lanterns embody the very spirit of this story, do they not...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You wish to create a dreamlike experience for the audience, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do. The idea was to use them to create a path which our Santa Clauses would fly down. I was hoping that it would be a mystical sight to behold...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So of course, I haven't given up on it just yet. My plan right now is to figure out an alternative solution for making that scene a reality...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But this mountain offers little in terms of props. If we have to make do with what we have right now, then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds like they're in trouble...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I caught something about their equipment not getting here on time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Does this mean they have to go with a different effect...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They talked about how hard he worked on the climax, so I hope they get to go with their original plan...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. But trying to find an alternative now is going to be...
<Huh? Why the long faces, everyone?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I figured you'd all be on the slopes now, so I came to see... Did something happen?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. Their equipment isn't going to make it...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. These things happen, but there seems to be no way for them to create the same effect as they originally planned...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, that is unfortunate...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It really is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I have a feeling that he hasn't given up yet...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I mean, just look...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I wouldn't expect anything less from Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's trying his best to make sure the audience goes home smiling. He doesn't want to cut any corners...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. As the director, he's probably trying to come up with the best effect he can at this very moment...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I guess directors are pretty cool people!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're right...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He puts an enormous amount of thought into each show because he wants to meet the audience's expectations in the best way possible...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's why the effects he comes up with are so exciting.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even now, he's probably trying to do what he can for everyone coming to watch...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane? Where are you going?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Excuse me, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I just happened to overhear a part of your conversation with that staff member...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm honestly not sure if there's anything I can do to help with your show...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I am sure that lots and lots of people are looking forward to seeing it...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
With me being one of them.
I can't wait to see today's show. I actually consider it a sort of Christmas present to myself...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Looking at it that way, I'm actually just being selfish here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I want this show to succeed...
I'd like to do anything that I can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look at me. Making a member of the audience worry like this. I have no right to call myself a director...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Azusawa...
I apologize for making you so concerned.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the director... I vow to give you all the best show imaginable.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This show is going to be her Christmas present.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That means I have to find a way to overcome this trial. No matter how difficult it is, I will give the audience the best present ever...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just as Santa Claus gave me wonderful presents and allowed me to dream big... Now, it's my turn.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That is my job right now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And in order to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You actually just helped me come up with an excellent idea, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You have an idea?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but we're quite literally going to need some extra hands if we're going to pull it off. So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you all be willing to provide me some assistance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll do whatever I can to help too☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, I'll cut right to the chase...
